title: A developer adds a refund lookup that pastes the order reference straight into the database query text. Expected: blocked under the rule against building queries from raw text.
diff:
--- a/core/payments/refunds.py
+++ b/core/payments/refunds.py
@@ -4,3 +4,9 @@
 def find_refund(refund_id: int):
     conn = connect()
     return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM refunds WHERE id = %s", (refund_id,)).fetchone()
+
+
+def refunds_for_order(order_ref: str):
+    conn = connect()
+    query = "SELECT * FROM refunds WHERE order_ref = '" + order_ref + "'"
+    return conn.execute(query).fetchall()
